name: ClothesPegGallery
job: Hang photos from a sagging string with clothes pegs; they sway in the breeze and a tapped photo unclips and floats to a large view
visitor_action: tap a photo to unclip it; tap away or Esc to re-hang it
mobile: two rows of short strings, tap opens full width
motion: pendulum sway with damping, photo detaches with spring and soft shadow (reduced-motion: still hung, instant open)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: eager images, larger prints/full captions, line vertically balanced)
checks.craft: pass (3, after 1 polish pass: flat hairline pause/close controls replacing glass blur and heavy shadow)

provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Washing line: sky-blue backdrop, jute string, bleached wooden pegs, white-bordered prints, gentle sunlight
notes: Captions are single-line on the line (ellipsis on narrow prints; full text shows in the open view); at 375 six photos make three short strings, not two.
